articles.title: After deadly Kyiv strike, Ukraine warns interceptor shortage is costing lives
articles.description: Without Patriot interceptors, Ukraine's skies are wide open and people are fully exposed to Russia's missile barrages.

articles.title: Israel strikes south Lebanon after first evacuation warning in weeks
articles.description: Lebanon's health ministry says one person was killed in the strikes, which the Israeli military says were a response to a Hezbollah ceasefire violation.

articles.title: Youth protests have weakened Modi, Indian activist who went on hunger strike tells BBC
articles.description: The "cockroach" movement was one of the biggest public displays of dissent against India's prime minister in years.

articles.title: Watch: 'Scariest night' as Ukraine fails to intercept Russian attack
articles.description: Kyiv's depleted air defences meant many of the missiles were not intercepted - like the one that hit Anastasiia's home.

articles.title: Explosive drone 'attack' was 'professionally carried out'
articles.description: A drone carrying an explosive device that was found at Leipzig airport was "very professionally carried out", a German minister said.

articles.title: Sunken Nazi warships emerge from the Danube as water levels drop to record lows
articles.description: Water levels in the river Danube have fallen so low due to this summer's dry weather in Europe that sunken Nazi warships are appearing into view.
